findings.message:
Appending to a non-latest window leaves a permanent gap

After `jumpToMessage()`, `canLoadNewer` is true. An appended message lands at the end of the window and moves `newerId` to it. `canLoadNewer` then becomes false, and the skipped messages are never fetched. No shipped view calls `jumpToMessage`. The only listeners are `scroll-to-message` in the body partial and `open-attachment` at `Chat.php:110`, which has no dispatcher in the repo. So this is reachable through the public method or event, not the bundled UI. No test covers append-after-jump.
Fix: when `canLoadNewer` is true, don't append. Call `loadNewer()` until it is false, or reload the latest window.

Video layout changes after boot are never re-scrolled

The base code listened for `loadeddata` on video and re-scrolled at 400 ms (base `body.blade.php` lines 32 and 59–68). The head listens only to `load.capture` and `error.capture`, and `<video>` does not fire `load`. `initializing` clears at 220 ms, so a video whose metadata arrives later can leave the newest message below the fold.
Fix: add `x-on:loadedmetadata.capture` and `x-on:loadeddata.capture` to `<main>`. Not verified at runtime.

The jump lock is cleared by the jump's own scroll

After a jump, the re-centering branch in `onAnyMediaLoad` (`:178-180`) is effectively dead. Confidence is moderate, from code reading only.
Fix: route programmatic scroll writes (`scrollToBottom`, `scrollToMessageCenter`, `restoreToAnchor`) through one helper that also updates `lastScrollTop`.

Every append runs an O(conversation) EXISTS scan

Each realtime or own message now runs two EXISTS queries. An appended message is always the newest, so the `canLoadNewer` predicate matches nothing and the database must read every row in the conversation. The only index is `index(['conversation_id'])` (`database/migrations/2024_11_01_000004_create_wirechat_messages_table.php:40`). The cost is linear in conversation length and paid per receiving tab and per sender. This also contradicts the PR's stated goal of less append-path resync. Actual cost was not measured.
Fix: on append, keep only `syncCursorsFromFlat`. Recompute flags only when the window was empty, and only after fix 1 is in place.

Weakened style assertion

The regex changed from the exact `style="contain:content; min-height: 24rem;"` to `style="[^"]*min-height: 24rem;[^"]*"`. The shell view `resources/views/livewire/chat/chat.blade.php:8-11` is unchanged in this PR, and the new pattern no longer requires `contain:content`. Nothing in the diff justifies the loosening.
Fix: restore a pattern that requires `contain:content;` before `min-height`.
